content: It’s been a while since we’ve seen a good discount on the Apple AirPods Pro 3, but like the latest iPad Mini and the M5 MacBook Airs, a great one is happening now for October Prime Day. You can snag a pair of the noise-canceling earbuds that include five ear tip sizes, live translation, and fantastic sound for $179 at Amazon (originally $249). I expect other retailers to offer a similar price in the coming days. This is the first time the price has gone below $190 since Prime Day in June. Since then, Apple launched the AirPods 5, and the most feature-complete version with a wireless charging case costs $149.99. Those are great if you prefer earbuds that don’t form a seal in your ears, but for everyone else, the AirPods Pro 3 are a much better value at just $30 more right now. chineseContent: 我们已经有一段时间没有看到 Apple AirPods Pro 3 的大幅折扣了，但与最新的 iPad Mini 和 M5 MacBook Air 一样，现在 10 月 Prime Day 也将迎来一场大折扣。你可以在亚马逊以 179 美元（原价 249 美元）购买一副降噪耳塞，它有五种耳塞尺寸、实时翻译和美妙的声音。我预计其他零售商在未来几天也会提供类似的价格。这是自 6 月份 Prime Day 以来价格首次跌破 190 美元。此后，苹果推出了AirPods 5，功能最齐全的带无线充电盒的版本售价为149.99美元。如果您更喜欢不会在耳朵中形成密封的耳塞，那么这些耳机就很棒，但对于其他人来说，AirPods Pro 3 的价值要高得多，目前只需多出 30 美元。 [产品：AirPods Pro 3 | https://www.amazon.com/Apple-Cancellation-Translation-Headphones-High-Fidelity/dp/B0FQFB8FMG?tag=theverge02-20]阅读我们的 AirPods Pro 3 评论。
